name: skilltree-memory
description: SkillTree classroom memory plugin — per-student Cognee GraphRAG datasets. Registers 3 model tools: memory_ingest (Caliper/progress events -> the student's cognee dataset), memory_ask (Q&A over one student's evolving knowledge), memory_evolve (periodic knowledge-evolution pipeline). Dataset isolation: student-<candidateId> (candidateId comes from class-service M6). Talks to the Cognee MCP server already wired in plugins/patch.yml (row mcp-cognee-memory). No LLM key lives in this plugin: entity extraction runs inside the Cognee MCP server, whose LLM gateway (NetMind) is configured via env from skilltree-secrets/netmind.json.
